purpose: Measure patient-level development yield of the deterministic balanced-then-maximal cascade after both control-flow counterexamples passed.

execution.selection_rule: For each patient, use the first dual-operation topology pass in frozen source order; stop on the first indeterminate source instead of skipping it.
execution.stdout_policy: per-source logs only; controller stdout redirected to a bounded run log

failure_policy: Any timeout, nonzero exit, missing receipt, identity mismatch, or regression is HOLD with no automatic retry.
authorization_basis: Codex self-authorized the complete development partition after the maximal fallback produced an accepted 73,591-pixel U2 witness and a separate prior balanced dual-operation patient passed without any maximal invocation.
